title: LLM mods
summary: Every agent and model provider is a mod. Install them from the site, or create your own to connect another command-line program or an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API. Jev treats them all the same, with the same gates, routing and usage records.
usage: Click Create mod in Settings › Mods (or Ctrl+K). It opens Dashboard › Mods on the site for the current environment. For a command-line mod, give the program and its command line: {model} becomes the chosen model and {prompt}, alone in an argument, the request (without it, the request goes through standard input). If the program writes to the project, also give a read-only line for planning. For an API mod, choose OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic and enter the address. The mod reaches the app at the next sync; there, add the API key if needed (it stays on this computer) and turn on the models Jev may use. In an organization's projects, its LLM policy applies: if it lists allowed agents, the mods you create stay off there.
